Xingyu Lai is an interdisciplinary artist from China. Her art practice is deeply rooted in painting, which serves as the foundation of her work, but has organically expanded into sculpture, ceramics, photography, and interactive installations over time. She focuses on the subtle habits of the body, exploring how innate actions—breathing, nursing, and circulating blood—connect individuals to one another and to the systems they inhabit. These small, often overlooked behaviors shape perception, emotion, and psychology in profound ways. Centered on the human experience, her work investigates the relationships between the body, identity, and everyday life. Her practice aims to reveal these invisible links, allowing viewers to sense the presence and significance of the body through observation or participation.

赖星羽是一位来自中国的跨学科艺术家。她的艺术实践深深扎根于绘画——绘画是她全部创作的基础，并随着时间自然地延展至雕塑、陶瓷、摄影与互动装置。她关注身体细微的习惯，探索呼吸、哺乳、血液循环这些与生俱来的行为如何将个体彼此相连，又如何将个体与他们所栖居的系统相连。这些微小而常被忽视的行为，以深刻的方式塑造着感知、情绪与心理。以人的经验为中心，她的作品追问身体、身份与日常生活之间的关系。她的实践试图揭示这些不可见的联结，让观者通过观看或参与，感受到身体的存在与意义。
